newsitem.title: INDONESIA: BASKETBALL-Indonesia still mulling Magic Johnson visit-paper.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-Indonesia still mulling Magic Johnson visit-paper.

text.p: Indonesian immigration officials have not yet decided on whether to allow former U.S. basketball star Earvin "Magic" Johnson to visit Indonesia, local media reported on Saturday.
Johnson, who stunned the sports world in 1991 when he announced he had become infected with HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, is scheduled to hold a basketball exhibition in Jakarta next week.
The Republika newspaper said on Saturday that immigration officials had not decided to allow Johnson into the country.

Indonesia's immigration act stated that the government was entitled to reject anybody whose illness could endanger other people, immigration spokesman Mursanuddin Ghani was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
"We are still consulting other related institutions," he said. The paper gave no further details.
Johnson was denied a visa to enter Indonesia in 1994.
The World Health Organisation has said as many as 500,000 Indonesians might be infected with the virus.
Indonesia has put the number of HIV or AIDS-related deaths at 465. But health workers said that figure only represented reported cases and the real number could be as much as a hundred times greater.
Indonesia has a population of nearly 200 million people, the world's fourth most populous nation.
